description: Resolve a company domain or name to its LinkedIn company URL with a confidence score, firmographics, and social links as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. Provide at least one of company_domain or company_name. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Required if company_name is not provided.

company_name.description: Company name. Required if company_domain is not provided.

includeFirmographics.description: When "true", also fetches the public LinkedIn company page to add employee count, industry, HQ, follower count and description. Off by default because it is the most expensive step. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

skipCache.description: When "false", the default, a successful resolution is cached for 7 days and reused. Set "true" to force a fresh resolution. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

name: resolve_linkedin_url
title: Resolve LinkedIn URL
